# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta25

## Legacy YAML cleanup

This beta removes compatibility-only configuration fields that were retained during earlier migrations. The supported YAML surface now follows the same canonical keys shown by the Visual Editor.

Removed legacy fields:

- `mower_entity` — use `entity`.
- `session_count` — removed; History already shows all sessions for the selected day. Use `history_days` to control the available day range and `show_session_legend` for the session-time row.
- `osm_underlay_opacity` — use `underlay_opacity`.
- `notification_page_size` — use `notification_count`.
- `mower_body_color` and `mower_accent_color` — dead pre-artwork settings; mower appearance is now model artwork plus `mower_scale`.

## Runtime cleanup

- Remove the obsolete History session-limit branch and its render-key dependencies.
- Remove old mower-entity YAML alias checks while retaining the internal resolved `mower_entity` runtime property.
- Use `underlay_opacity` throughout the entire underlay pipeline instead of creating and later translating the old OSM-specific field.
- Use `notification_count` throughout the notification compatibility chain.
- Multi mower Notifications now match the Single mower behavior: one scrollable list limited by `notification_count`, with no legacy page state or Previous/Next pager.
- Remove dead mower body/accent defaults that were no longer consumed by the artwork renderer.

This is an intentional beta-series compatibility break for obsolete YAML aliases. Cards created or saved by the current Visual Editor already use the canonical fields.
